name: Eggman Empire... Yeah Right.
source:
You (among possible thousands) have been invited to Sonic's Surprise 25th Anniversary Party!
There will be lots of chili-dogs, candy, and amazing party games to play with each other.

... But there's just one problem.
I distracted Sonic so that we can get the cake for his Anniversary Party, and...
He hasn't come back yet.

Should we go look for him? If so, then where should we go?
I guess... there's only one way to find out...

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Eggman-Empire-Yeah-Right-Parody/242519] Gamejolt[/url]]
